shadows.name: sky-float
shadows.purpose: Every floating surface: cards, tags, kite labels, active nav pill, status chip, mobile menu. Token: var(--shadow).

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Presses, entrances, string draw, kite tug.

motion.name: rise
motion.value: 520ms ease-out; opacity 0.4 to 1, translateY 10px; staggered by --d

motion.name: sway
motion.value: 4-7s ease-in-out infinite alternate; rotate 1.4-4deg each way from top centre

motion.name: tug
motion.purpose: Pointer pass, press, or brisk scroll.

components.css: :host{--sky-0:#f3fbfc;--sky-1:#e1f5f8;--surface:#fff;--surface-2:#f0f9fa;--ink:#0b2a4a;--ink-2:#33586b;--ink-3:#4b6a78;--line:#cfe6ea;--primary:#0b6f7c;--primary-ink:#fff;--manjha:#c8401a;--kite-red:#e0402f;--kite-green:#2f9e44;--kite-marigold:#f2a516;--wa:#25d366;--wa-ink:#04301a;--shadow:0 1px 2px rgb(11 42 74 / 0.06),0 8px 24px -8px rgb(11 42 74 / 0.18);--ease-out:cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1);font-family:Poppins,ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif}.ds-ceiling{position:relative;width:360px;padding-bottom:16px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--sky-0),var(--sky-1))}.ds-string{position:absolute;top:0;left:0;width:100%;height:40px}.ds-row{position:relative;display:flex;justify-content:space-around;margin:0;padding:0;list-style:none}.ds-kite{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;text-decoration:none;transform-origin:50% 0;animation:ds-sway var(--dur) ease-in-out infinite alternate}.ds-drop{display:block;width:1px;background:var(--manjha);opacity:.7}.ds-k{width:52px;height:62px;filter:drop-shadow(0 6px 8px rgb(11 42 74 / .18));transition:transform 220ms var(--ease-out)}.ds-kite:hover .ds-k{transform:translateY(3px) scale(1.04)}.ds-kite:active .ds-k{transform:translateY(4px) scale(.97)}.ds-kite:focus-visible{outline:none}.ds-kite:focus-visible .ds-k{outline:2px solid var(--primary);outline-offset:4px}.ds-lbl{margin-top:6px;border-radius:999px;background:var(--surface);padding:2px 10px;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:600;line-height:20px;color:var(--ink);box-shadow:var(--shadow)}@keyframes ds-sway{from{transform:rotate(-3deg)}to{transform:rotate(3deg)}}@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-kite{animation:none}}

narrative.northStar: The Shop Ceiling on Festival Week
narrative.overview:
The site is the inside of a kite shop in the days before Makar Sankranti: kites hung on taut manjha strings, swaying over an aqua sky lifted from the shop's visiting card. Grounds are a vertical sky gradient with three drifting SVG wave layers at the foot; content sits on white cards and pill controls that float in that sky. Deep navy carries the text, a single teal carries action, and the kite-paper colours (red, blue, marigold, green, pink) appear only where something is a kite or marks a kite's category.

One structural line runs through the whole world: the manjha, a thin vermilion string (1.6px) that sags in a quadratic curve from edge to edge. Categories hang from it as diamond kites; featured stock hangs from it on wooden pegs at varied drops; on content lists it becomes a straight top rule with a kite mark pinned to it. Everything hanging sways on a slow pendulum and tugs when a pointer passes, a finger presses, or the page scrolls briskly.

Night mode is the same shop after dark: an indigo-navy sky, the waves recoloured and edged with a faint aqua glow line, small twinkling stars in the open sky, and every kite colour lifted in lightness so it stays saturated against the dark. Density is relaxed and mobile-first; tap targets are 44px or more and the primary contact actions sit at thumb reach.
keyCharacteristics: Aqua sky gradient with three drifting wave layers (from the visiting card) as the hero ground.
Navy ink, one teal action colour, kite-paper colours reserved for kites and category marks.
The manjha string (1.6px, sagging curve) as the structural rule and hanging rail.
Diamond kite silhouette as the recurring mark: category tags, bullets, success state.
Pendulum sway plus tug as the signature motion; all of it stops under reduced motion.
Poppins only, 400 to 700; Hindi and English set in the same face.
Full light and dark themes through the same token names.

rules.name: The One Teal Rule
rules.body: Action is teal and only teal. A second action colour exists only for WhatsApp, and it is WhatsApp's own green.

rules.name: The Kite Paper Rule
rules.body: Kite-paper colours fill kites, product art and category marks, and signal error, open and selection. They are never a section ground, a button, or running text.

rules.name: The Same Names Rule
rules.body: Every colour is a CSS custom property redefined under `.dark`. Components reference the token, never a literal, so night mode costs nothing.

rules.name: The One Face Rule
rules.body: Poppins only, 400 to 700. No second family, no script or decorative face, no system display face.

rules.name: The Bilingual Rule
rules.body: Hindi and English share the same face, sizes and weights. The language toggle swaps the copy, never the type scale.

rules.name: The One Float Rule
rules.body: Every floating surface uses the same sky-float shadow token plus the aqua ring. No per-component shadow recipes.

dos: Do set every colour through its token so `.dark` can redefine it.
Do hang kites and featured stock from a manjha curve that runs edge to edge, and pin kite marks to straight 1.5px manjha rules on lists.
Do keep the WhatsApp and Call pair together, full width at the bottom of the phone viewport.
Do give every pressable a 0.97 press scale and a 2.5px teal focus outline at 3px offset.
Do stop wave drift, sway, drift and twinkle under reduced motion, and draw the string in its final state.
Do start entrance animations at 0.4 opacity so a stalled animation never hides content.
donts: Don't use kite-paper colours for section grounds, buttons, or running text.
Don't add a second typeface or any weight outside 400 to 700.
Don't use hard offset shadows or per-component shadow recipes; use the sky-float token.
Don't delay navigation to finish a kite's tug animation.
